Objective
Establish whether the owner-facing Review & Approval Hub can be maintained, and specify a regenerable replacement projected from the control plane.
Done when
A specification exists for an owner-facing view generated deterministically from validated .agentops state (as the Owner HUD already is), covering which Hub sections carry real signal, which depend on evidence that no longer exists, and what the migration costs.
Next action
Audit the committed Hub output against live control-plane state, record exactly which sections are stale and which are unrecoverable, then specify the regenerable replacement. Do not edit review-approval-hub/** - it is build output with no source in this repository and would be clobbered by any rebuild.
